name: 얼굴 주름 일관성 분석
description: Analyzes wrinkle pattern and depth consistency
algorithm: Facial Wrinkle Consistency — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial wrinkle patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Wrinkle감지&분류**: Wrinkles are detected using multi-scale ridge detection and classified by type: dynamic wrinkles (appear during expressions — forehead furrows, crow's feet), static wrinkles (always present — nasolabial folds), and fine lines (aging-related texture). Each wrinkle's depth, length, and position are measured.

2. **Expression-Wrinkle상관**: Dynamic wrinkles must correlate with facial expressions — forehead wrinkles with brow raise (AU1/AU2), crow's feet with cheek raise (AU6), nasolabial deepening with smile (AU12). The method verifies these anatomical correlations. Deepfakes may produce expressions without corresponding wrinkles or wrinkles without corresponding expressions.

3. **WrinklePosition안정성**: Static wrinkles occupy fixed positions determined by skin's collagen structure. The method tracks wrinkle positions across frames — wrinkle locations should remain stable (may vary in visibility with expression but not in position). Temporal wrinkle position drift indicates AI generation.

4. **WrinkleRenderingQuality**: Wrinkles have specific rendering characteristics: they are valleys in the skin surface creating linear shadows with depth-dependent width. The method evaluates wrinkle rendering quality — AI generators often produce wrinkles that are too sharp (drawn lines) or too diffuse (lacking proper 3D depth cues).

5. **Age-AppropriateWrinkle매핑**: The wrinkle pattern should be age-appropriate: young faces have few static wrinkles, aged faces show predictable wrinkle progression (forehead → crow's feet → nasolabial → marionette). The method checks wrinkle pattern consistency with apparent age. Face-swapped deepfakes may show wrinkle-age mismatches.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through facial wrinkle consistency analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
